# NetBots SMC-(PRIVATE)LIMITED

> NetBots is a premier software engineering, applied AI, and digital marketing agency headquartered in Skardu, Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan, delivering cloud-native applications, AI automation, and custom web architecture globally.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Custom Software Development](https://netbots.io/services/software-dev): High-performance, server-side rendered (SSR) web systems with clean semantic markup, low INP, and zero layout shifts built on Next.js, Node.js, and MongoDB/PostgreSQL.
- [Applied AI & Workflow Automation](https://netbots.io/services/ai-automation): Autonomous 24/7 AI agents, local LLM integrations (Ollama, Llama), privacy-preserving Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and intelligent process automation.
- [Product Strategy & UI/UX Engineering](https://netbots.io/services/ui-ux): User research, interactive system prototypes, and modern, high-converting digital interfaces engineered for accessibility and scale.
- [Growth Marketing & Technical SEO / AEO](https://netbots.io/services/marketing): High-intent organic search optimization, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and programmatic marketing systems.

## Flagship Products

- [HotelSync](https://netbots.io/products/hotel-sync): Cloud-native Property Management System (PMS) and real-time OTA Channel Manager for hotels and resorts, featuring automated billing, room grids, and multi-channel synchronization.
- [Accounta](https://netbots.io/products#accounta): Financial intelligence SaaS and cloud ERP with automated reconciliation, multi-currency reporting, and predictive cash flow analytics.
- [E-Pharma](https://netbots.io/products#e-pharma): Clinical POS and pharmacy management system with batch-level expiry tracking, automated supplier reordering, and inventory intelligence.
